lines.line: Close my eyes and I fall asleep
Wondering if you're still there
Lost someone I love so deep, that's a hole I can't repair
Focused on my grind, never backing down
Never giving up, you're always on my mind
But memories are not enough
Yeah, every time I miss you
Every day I've been having issues
With some of them I try to replace you
But you never go away, always here to stay
Every Christmas Eve, every holiday
I play your favorite song 'cause it reminds me
You're never really gone, you're still right here
I walk these streets with my head down low
Talking to shadows only I know
I see your smile in the morning rain
Hear your voice in the wind again
I keep moving, chasing my dreams
But you're stitched inside the seams
No matter how far or how near
It's your heartbeat that I hear
Every time I miss you
Every day I've been having issues
With some of them I try to replace you
But you never go away, always here to stay
Every Christmas Eve, every holiday
I play your favorite song 'cause it reminds me
You're never really gone, you're still right here
Some nights you're standing close
Whispering things only you know
I tell myself it's just a dream
But it feels so real to me
I'm holding on, but I'm breaking too
Trying to live this life without you
Every time I miss you
Every day I've been having issues
With some of them I try to replace you
But you never go away, you're always here to stay
Every Christmas Eve, every holiday
I play your favorite song 'cause it reminds me
You're never really gone, you're still right here
So every day I'll be daydreaming
Praying one day I'll lose this feeling
But for right now, you're still right here somehow
